name: 53718 · Madison, WI
findings: ZIP 53718 (Madison) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53718 (Madison) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53718 (Madison) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).
